itens.titulo: Grupos alinhados com a Rússia colaboram em ciberataque destrutivo contra empresa na Ucrânia
itens.resumo: Dois grupos de atacantes alinhados com a Rússia fizeram parte de uma operação contra uma empresa ucraniana de logística de cereais. Uma investigação da ESET mostra como os grupos se infiltraram na rede e usaram uma backdoor até agora desconhecida para preparar um ataque concebido para destruir dados. The post Grupos alinhados com a Rússia colaboram em ciberataque destrutivo contra empresa na Ucrânia appeared first on Tek Notícias .

itens.titulo: A regra de backups 3-2-1-1-0 é a nova ciberresiliência contra o ransomware
itens.resumo: Com os ciberataques a visar em primeiro lugar os repositórios de cópias de segurança, a tradicional estratégia de proteção de dados tornou-se insuficiente, exigindo uma evolução para garantir a recuperação efetiva da informação. The post A regra de backups 3-2-1-1-0 é a nova ciberresiliência contra o ransomware appeared first on Tek Notícias .

itens.titulo: CVE-2026-41709: Broadcom VMWare ESX Insufficient Logging Vulnerability
itens.resumo: Broadcom VMWare ESX contains an insufficient logging vulnerability that could allow a malicious actor with admin access to perform certain operations without being logged.
itens.titulo_pt: CVE-2026-41709: Vulnerabilidade de registo insuficiente do Broadcom VMWare ESX
itens.resumo_pt: O Broadcom VMWare ESX contém uma vulnerabilidade de registo insuficiente que pode permitir que um agente mal-intencionado com acesso de administrador execute determinadas operações sem ser registrado.

itens.titulo: CVE-2026-46300: Linux Kernel Missing Initialization of a Variable Vulnerability
itens.resumo: Linux Kernel contains a missing initialization of a variable vulnerability that could allow for unintended modification of page-cache-backed data via failure to preserve the shared-fragment marker during socket buffer coalescing, causing ESP input processing to decrypt shared fragments in place. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 to implant PHP webshells and run commands as root.

itens.titulo: CVE-2026-118579: A weakness has been identified in D-Link DIR-505 1.10B02
itens.resumo: A weakness has been identified in D-Link DIR-505 1.10B02. The impacted element is the function main of the file /secmark1524.cgi of the component Web Management CGI. This manipulation of the argument accu/pass/code/hash/cmds causes backdoor. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks.

itens.resumo: A Missing authentication for critical function vulnerability in Juniper Networks Session Smart Router allows an unauthenticated network-based attacker to obtain administrative privileges by passing crafted URL parameters to an insecure endpoint running as root. itens.titulo: CVE-2026-115893: Wasmtime: Cranelift backend on aarch64 can jump to incorrect target on large Wasm `br_table` instruction
itens.resumo: When running with the Cranelift compiler backend on an aarch64 target, Wasmtime can compile a Wasm module with more than ~256k targets on one br_table instruction in a way that results in an incorrect conditional branch target. This conditional branch could then jump to arbitrary other code (at an user-controlled offset), leading to arbitrary sandbox escapes. Any Wasmtime engine running on aarch64 with default settings can be forced to jump to arbitrary code by a user-controlled Wasm module. itens.titulo: CVE-2026-118690: Signal K Server before 2.33.0 contains a missing authentication vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to download log…
itens.resumo: Signal K Server before 2.33.0 contains a missing authentication vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to download log archives via the /skServer/ziplogs endpoint. Attackers can extract the JWT secretKey from security.json in the ZIP, forge administrator tokens, and create persistent admin accounts for full server control.
